answer: Proof of Personhood via biometrically anchored hardware tokens forces an attacker to acquire distinct physical assets for every node in an ocean of digital agents. This mechanism ensures that each identity is a unique ember of cryptographically verified biological input, preventing a whisper of malicious code from spawning thousands of sybils. The cost of an attack shifts from negligible computational cycles to the prohibitive expense of harvesting genuine biometric data at a massive scale.
